description: Organ Pipes National Park, Volcanic Plains Bioregion, VIC. VAST-2: Tracking the Transformation of Australia's Vegetated Landscapes is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. The aim of this project is to compile land use and management practices and their observed and measured impacts and effects on vegetation condition. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. Its tags are Cropping, Ploughing, Restoration, Revegetation, Sheep grazing. It offers 10 resource(s) in html, pdf, png, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
